sources.title: SeanWang0027/qwen3-1.7b-textcraft-sft-qwen3-32b-traj · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Nothing filtered: failed episodes are included. Data: 6 Qwen3-32B trajectories per training task (2132 episodes), 1 epoch = 66 steps. Stored in bf16. TextCraft official test split (100 tasks), avg of 4 passes, temperature 0.4, 512 tokens/turn, 30 turns, thinking off.

sources.title: SeanWang0027/qwen3-1.7b-babyai-tcod-b2f-qwen3-32b-ep1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: TCOD backward-to-forward (the gold prefix shrinks, checkpoint_steps 5). Code: kokolerk/TCOD + FutureBridge-OPD overlay (trinity-rft), BabyAI port as in docs/TCOD_BABYAI.md of the online-rose repo (branch tcod-babyai): student Qwen3-1.7B, teacher Qwen3-32B bf16, thinking off, the conversation of babyai/eval_babyai.py, 20 turns, the 810 official train tasks, batch 16 episodes / 64 turns, lr 1e-6, kl_coef 1.0, three passes over the data = 152 explorer steps.
